notes: the preamble «ما كان فيه عن حماد بن عمرو؛ و أنس بن محمد» names the book's sources; the two routes after it are the chains, and the first carries Hammad b. Amr and Ja'far
«أحمد بن صالح التميمي» is one link after «أبي:» (rule 7); the colon is not a break
the second route carries the will's words («يا علي أوصيك بوصية»), the first is its chain to Ali; both end at Ali, written after «عن» so narrator
«أبيه» and «جده» without names are relations (rule 7); the blessings are not part of the surfaces
